title: A reviewer's decision lands on another member's case
scenario: After a performance release, a nurse's approval for one member and a medical director's denial for another both appeared on a third member's determination letter. The app team suspects thread ids derived from member ids. Replay the review burst, read the audit trail, find the real cause and fix the review service.
task: Reproduce the burst and map each submission to the thread it resumed
Test the thread-id theory and find the real cause
Fix the service and add a wrong-thread guard
Fill in findings.json; write what Privacy should be told
acceptance: Concurrent bursts land every decision on its own case and member
Each thread finalizes once by the right reviewer; no shared mutable config
Root cause backed by repro and audit evidence
